# How much of what you earn should you set aside for tax?

> Free German freelancer tax calculator (Freiberufler and Gewerbe): enter turnover and expenses to see Einkommensteuer under the 2026 tariff, Soli, Kirchensteuer, Gewerbesteuer and how much of every invoice to set aside. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
